title: The Column With No Date
summary: Day 4, INCONSISTENCY, and the phase turns here. Singular, and it has an ordinary explanation everyone reaches for: somebody forgot to write the date. Grants the fact rather than requiring it, because an anchor is mandatory content and theo_ledger_question reaches only about five runs in six; the prose branches on whether the player already knew.
